component.name: PlayDeck
component.summary: Plex client for SteamOS Gaming Mode with real HDR output

description.p: PlayDeck is a gamepad-driven 10-foot Plex client built for the Steam Deck OLED in SteamOS Gaming Mode (gamescope), combining a 90 fps browse UI with full-screen Direct Play HDR10 and Dolby Vision playback through mpv.
